<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

use React\Promise\PromiseInterface;
use React\EventLoop\LoopInterface;

class BlockchainCryptoProvider
{
    private string $masterKey;
    private array $nonceRegistry;
    private int $blockHeight;
    private string $chainId;

    public function __construct(string $masterKey, string $chainId)
    {
        $this->masterKey = hash('sha384', $masterKey, true);
        $this->nonceRegistry = [];
        $this->blockHeight = 0;
        $this->chainId = $chainId;
    }

    public function deriveBlockKey(int $blockHeight): string
    {
        return hash_hmac('sha256', pack('N', $blockHeight) . $this->chainId, $this->masterKey, true);
    }

    public function generateIV(int $blockHeight, string $txHash): string
    {
        $material = $this->chainId . pack('N', $blockHeight) . $txHash;
        $iv = substr(hash('sha256', $material, true), 0, 16);
        return $iv;
    }

    public function registerNonce(string $iv, int $blockHeight): bool
    {
        $bucket = $blockHeight >> 4;
        if (!isset($this->nonceRegistry[$bucket])) {
            $this->nonceRegistry[$bucket] = [];
        }
        $ivHex = bin2hex($iv);
        if (in_array($ivHex, $this->nonceRegistry[$bucket], true)) {
            return false;
        }
        $this->nonceRegistry[$bucket][] = $ivHex;
        return true;
    }

    public function pruneRegistry(int $currentBlock): void
    {
        $currentBucket = $currentBlock >> 4;
        foreach (array_keys($this->nonceRegistry) as $bucket) {
            if ($bucket < $currentBucket - 2) {
                unset($this->nonceRegistry[$bucket]);
            }
        }
    }
}

class SmartContractExecutor
{
    private BlockchainCryptoProvider $crypto;
    private array $pendingTransactions;
    private int $currentBlock;

    public function __construct(BlockchainCryptoProvider $crypto)
    {
        $this->crypto = $crypto;
        $this->pendingTransactions = [];
        $this->currentBlock = 0;
    }

    public function submitTransaction(string $payload, string $sender): PromiseInterface
    {
        return \React\Promise\resolve(null)->then(function () use ($payload, $sender) {
            $txHash = $this->computeTxHash($payload, $sender);
            $this->pendingTransactions[] = [
                'hash' => $txHash,
                'payload' => $payload,
                'sender' => $sender,
                'block' => $this->currentBlock,
            ];
            return $txHash;
        });
    }

    public function sealBlock(): PromiseInterface
    {
        return \React\Promise\resolve(null)->then(function () {
            $block = $this->currentBlock;
            $sealed = [];

            foreach ($this->pendingTransactions as $tx) {
                $encrypted = $this->encryptTransaction($tx, $block);
                if ($encrypted !== null) {
                    $sealed[] = $encrypted;
                }
            }

            $this->pendingTransactions = [];
            $this->currentBlock++;
            $this->crypto->pruneRegistry($this->currentBlock);

            return ['block' => $block, 'transactions' => $sealed];
        });
    }

    private function encryptTransaction(array $tx, int $blockHeight): ?array
    {
        $key = $this->crypto->deriveBlockKey($blockHeight);
        $iv = $this->crypto->generateIV($blockHeight, $tx['hash']);

        $registered = $this->crypto->registerNonce($iv, $blockHeight);
        if (!$registered) {
            $iv = $this->crypto->generateIV($blockHeight, $tx['hash'] . random_bytes(4));
            $this->crypto->registerNonce($iv, $blockHeight);
        }

        $ciphertext = openssl_encrypt(
            $tx['payload'],
            'aes-256-cbc',
            $key,
            OPENSSL_RAW_DATA,
            $iv
        );

        return [
            'ct' => base64_encode($ciphertext),
            'iv' => base64_encode($iv),
            'txid' => $tx['hash'],
        ];
    }

    private function computeTxHash(string $payload, string $sender): string
    {
        return hash('sha256', $payload . $sender . pack('N', $this->currentBlock));
    }
}

class ContractStateManager
{
    private SmartContractExecutor $executor;
    private array $stateLog;

    public function __construct(SmartContractExecutor $executor)
    {
        $this->executor = $executor;
        $this->stateLog = [];
    }

    public function executeTransfer(string $from, string $to, int $amount): PromiseInterface
    {
        $payload = json_encode(['op' => 'transfer', 'from' => $from, 'to' => $to, 'amount' => $amount]);
        return $this->executor->submitTransaction($payload, $from)->then(function ($txHash) use ($from, $to, $amount) {
            $this->stateLog[] = ['tx' => $txHash, 'from' => $from, 'to' => $to, 'amount' => $amount];
            return $txHash;
        });
    }

    public function batchExecute(array $transfers): PromiseInterface
    {
        $promises = [];
        foreach ($transfers as $t) {
            $promises[] = $this->executeTransfer($t['from'], $t['to'], $t['amount']);
        }
        return \React\Promise\all($promises)->then(function ($results) {
            return $this->executor->sealBlock()->then(function ($block) use ($results) {
                return ['txids' => $results, 'block' => $block];
            });
        });
    }
}
